AULA F108 Full-Size Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard (108 Keys Layout / Hot-Swappable / Pre-Lubed Linear Switches / Creamy Acoustic Profile / 4000mAh Battery / Dynamic RGB)

Experience the perfect fusion of comprehensive functionality and premium typing acoustic performance with the AULA F108 Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard, now available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Featuring a 100% full-size layout configuration with a complete 108-key arrangement, this desktop workhorse incorporates a dedicated numeric keypad for peak productivity tracking. Built upon a high-end Gasket-Mounted structural architecture combined with multi-layered internal dampening foam layers, it delivers a satisfyingly soft, signature "creamy" sound profile with enhanced key stroke cushion. The F108 comes equipped with factory pre-lubed linear mechanical switches tailored for instant execution on ultra-durable hot-swappable sockets. Offering ultimate platform versatility, its high-speed Tri-Mode connectivity ecosystem seamlessly transitions between low-latency 2.4GHz wireless via USB dongle, stable Bluetooth 5.0 wireless, and reliable USB-C wired mode. Backed by a robust 4000mAh rechargeable battery matrix and illuminated by a highly customizable dynamic RGB backlighting system framework, this mechanical layout represents the absolute standard for immersive desktop setups.
